The stated condition $y_2\ge y_1$ is insufficient for the x-axis formula unless both are nonnegative radius values; likewise clarify that x-axis and y-axis formulas subtract squared distances from the rotation axis. Regions crossing the axis require determining the actual cross-section rather than automatically subtracting the two boundary squares.
summary: Qualified the theory intro and annulus fact to include solid discs, and clarified that both axis formulas subtract squared nonnegative distances from the rotation axis with the stated coordinate formulas requiring nonnegative ordered boundaries. Added guidance to determine actual cross-sections for regions crossing the axis; all practice items, quiz questions, diagrams, solutions and procedure headings remain unchanged, and no whole items were removed.
